name: The Brightest Star
source:
A girl named Cosmi from the organization [REDACTED] receives an order for the protagonist. She finds him cute and decides to take him to her basement where he won't be found. Whether the protagonist gets out or stays there forever is up to you.

[Translated from [url=https://vikamen10.itch.io/the-brightest-star]itch.io[/url]]
